name: Hands folded on the back of a chair
summary:
A study of clasped hands resting on the back of a chair. On the back are two sketches of a seated Western woman. 
Joseph Jardine (to whom the inscription refers) was a nephew of Dr William Jardine, founder of Jardine, Matheson & Co.; he came to China in 1843, the year of his uncle's death in Englan
